title: Electricity crises in South Africa: jobs, investment, exporting and manufacturing vulnerability
summary: Firm-level evidence on what South Africa’s electricity crises cost manufacturers.
description: Research within UNU-WIDER's Southern Africa—Towards Inclusive Economic Development (SA-TIED) programme on what South Africa's electricity crises cost manufacturing. It builds an index of sub-sector energy vulnerability from input–output tables and uses firm-level tax data to trace effects on jobs, capital investment and exports.
